brief.story: A marketer stuck in a chat window finds the room of people who already figured it out.
brief.message: AI is changing marketing. Nobody has a prompt for that.

premise.pain: marketers who talk to AI all day
premise.stereotype: the assistant's em-dash habit and fake enthusiasm

promise.line: Half a day with marketers who already figured it out.
promise.does: spend half a day with marketers
promise.leaves: real systems that get real results

people.partners: excluded: none this year, decided by the organisers

voices.ai: three dots, then white type in the reply bubble

rows.action: the three typing dots bounce in an empty chat, then type a fast reply
the dots fall out of the chat and land in a crowd of dots
the crowd of dots wires itself into a network and spirals into one dot

counts.why: two dots join the network; one hops up and becomes the logo's dot

rows.action: the network thread becomes the mark's neck and the lockup rises
rows.bridge: the people who connected ARE the event
rows.builtFrom: the network thread and the one dot

rows.action: the lockup slides to the corner and the date, venue and call land on the grid
the dots type one last reply under the card
rows.answers: the call to reserve a spot on the card

jokes.who: anyone who chats with an assistant daily knows the opener

jokes.line: an 'I'm not a robot' box ticked at '100% in person'
jokes.butt: the situation of proving you are human

jokes.line: the dots hesitate, then type 'make no mistakes'
jokes.who: prompt writers recognise their own line
